```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="desk">

  <!-- ==================== Desk Top ==================== -->
  <link name="top">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.77-0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.56 0.78 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="oak">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.27 0.07 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.77-0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.56 0.78 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="12.0"/>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.77-0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.5" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.5" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.2"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- ==================== Legs ==================== -->
  <!-- Leg dimensions: 0.04 x 0.04 x 0.75 -->
  <xacro:macro name="leg" params="leg_name x y">
    <link name="${leg_name}">
      <visual>
        <origin xyz="${x} ${y} 0.375" rpy="0 0 0"/>
        <geometry>
          <box size="0.04 0.04 0.75"/>
        </geometry>
        <material name="metal">
          <color rgba="0.7 0.7 0.7 1"/>
        </material>
      </visual>
      <collision>
        <origin xyz="${x} ${y} 0.375" rpy="0 0 0"/>
        <geometry>
          <box size="0.04 0.04 0.75"/>
        </geometry>
      </collision>
      <inertial>
        <mass value="2.0"/>
        <origin xyz="${x} ${y} 0.375" rpy="0 0 0"/>
        <inertia ixx="0.01" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
                 iyy="0.01" iyz="0.0"
                 izz="0.008"/>
      </inertial>
    </link>

    <joint name="${leg_name}_joint" type="fixed">
      <parent link="top"/>
      <child link="${leg_name}"/>
      <origin xyz="${x} ${y} 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    </joint>
  </xacro:macro>

  <!-- Instantiate four legs -->
  <xacro:leg leg_name="leg_front_left"  x="-0.74" y="-0.37"/>
  <xacro:leg leg_name="leg_front_right" x=" 0.74" y="-0.37"/>
  <xacro:leg leg_name="leg_back_left"   x="-0.74" y=" 0.37"/>
  <xacro:leg leg_name="leg_back_right"  x=" 0.74" y=" 0.37"/>

  <!-- ==================== Drawer ==================== -->
  <link name="drawer">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.125 0.07" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.48 0.35 0.15"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_material">
        <color rgba="0.8 0.8 0.6 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.125 0.07" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.48 0.35 0.15"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="5.0"/>
      <origin xyz="0 0.125 0.07" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.12" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.12" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.02"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <joint name="drawer_joint" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="top"/>
    <child link="drawer"/>
    <!-- Drawer slides toward -Y (front). Origin at back of drawer when fully retracted -->
    <origin xyz="0 0.195 0.07" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 -1 0"/>
    <limit effort="100" velocity="0.2" lower="0.0" upper="0.30"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
```
